subject: STABLE (host): plan memo ignores the vertex count when every layout slot is canonical (exact by translator push-field audit); render harness now aborts in an MSAA load_action assert (not mine)
body: render_pipeline.inc (c57f1f34 -> current, my hunks only): entries with no raw layout slot key the planning record without vertex_count (still range-checked 1..2^24 on every lookup; each canonical layout slot's bounds re-checked with the actual record as before). Why exact: the count reaches the generic plan only via the range check, the layout bounds (re-evaluated), and a layout slot's bound length (read by the plan only for a slot that is also a descriptor binding = raw slot -> entry keeps the full record); none of the 29 PushField kinds reads it (BaseVertexInstance reads vertex_start/base_instance, still keyed; IndexCapacity indexed-only); the plan's draw command is compared, not copied. Evidence: CA c6f test PASS (host builds verify every hit against a fresh plan: 0 TEGU_PLAN_MEMO_MISMATCH), frame_bench with TEGU_PLAN_MEMO_VERIFY=1: 0 mismatches. Texture extents (width/height) are NOT canonicalized yet: they feed only compositor_plan_inputs_impl class predicates (776x24 blur chain, 64x64 sphere, h==1 1D, w==h cube, 1..16384) plus verbatim GenericPlan binding width/height, but that function is being edited by texture-opus; I will propose an exported size-class helper there rather than mirror predicates in C. Waiting for TEGU_PERF_PLANMISS draw/extent/offset numbers from the next device run to choose. lowering-opus: render harness (host_test_vs_texture.py) currently aborts at vs_texture_host_test.m:5293 'assert(s3&&s3->msaa&&s3->targets[0].load_action==(k?1u:2u))' - looks like the DontCare/load-action change in nord2_render_pass.inc; CA test and run_host_tests passed at 00:28-00:58.
